description: Create or update a named document to preserve findings and develop a shared investigation across runs. Include evidence, progress, and remaining questions. Pass thread to attach the document to a thread; preserve that owner on updates. Use expected_version 0 to create; otherwise pass the version you last read.

expected_version.description: 0 to create; otherwise the version you last read.

metadata.description: JSON object you control, at most 4,096 characters serialized.

name.description: Document name, unique within the space, including thread artifacts.

op_key.description: Operation key you choose, 8 to 128 characters. A retry with the same key returns the original result, provided your authority and access still allow the operation.

summary.description: Short description shown in discovery; derived from body when empty.

tags.description: Up to 20 tags of at most 64 characters, deduplicated and sorted.

thread.description: Thread that owns this artifact. Omit for a space document. Immutable after creation.

name: write_document
title: Write document
